description: Source code for the Drupal core class 'DatabaseDriver', which manages database driver extensions, including loading autoloaders, retrieving module info, and handling install tasks.

classes.name: DatabaseDriver
classes.description: Represents a database driver extension, managing autoloading, module info, and install tasks within Drupal.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module extension object containing the database driver.

methods.name: getDriverName
methods.description: Returns the name of the database driver.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the PHP namespace of the database driver.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the namespace as the driver name.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path to the driver source directory.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the class loader and sets up autoloading for the driver and dependencies.

methods.name: getInstallTasks
methods.description: Returns the install tasks object for the database driver.

methods.name: getAutoloadInfo
methods.description: Provides autoload namespace and directory info, including dependencies.

methods.name: isExperimental
methods.description: Checks if the module is marked as experimental.

methods.name: isObsolete
methods.description: Checks if the module is marked as obsolete.

methods.name: getModuleInfo
methods.description: Parses and retrieves the module's info.yml data.
